title: Takahē
blurb: The South Island takahē is a flightless swamphen indigenous to New Zealand and the largest living member of the rail family. It is often known by the abbreviated name takahē, which it shares with the recently extinct North Island takahē.
facts: The two takahē species are also known as notornis.
